title: Plato took ergot at Eleusis

tellings.quote: he went to Elusis and he was tripping on Urgot

plain: The Greek philosopher Plato, the author of The Republic, is said to have gone to Eleusis in Greece and been tripping on ergot there. Ergot is a fungus that grows on grain and can cause visions. Michels says this himself in a conversation about the psychedelic drug DMT, without naming a source, and it would mean that drug visions may have shaped one of the founders of Western thought.
